concept.title: Save Attachment Action
concept.shortdesc: The Save Attachment action saves the entire workbook or specific worksheets to the Notes and

conbody.p: The Save Attachment action saves the entire workbook or specific worksheets to the Notes and Attachments section of an Individual object. A new attachment is inserted each time this action is executed. This action does not provide any file locking. Use a Check-Out action if the file locking is required.

li.p: An attachment can be saved either in an Excel or PDF file format.
When an attachment is downloaded, the file name is the actual filename in your environment. <filename>.<extension>
Limitation in Apttus Intelligent Cloud environment
If a file with the same name and extension exists, a sequence number is appended after the filename, such as <filename> (2).<extension> and <filename> (3).<extension>.
To create a Save Attachment action, at least one object must be identified as an Individual.
